gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and its mean line high. Baloo Thambi 2 above it is deep-bodied and playful, so a long run of text feels sturdy and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-cascadia-code: Balsamiq Sans draws every line like a stencil-cut channel, smooth and never pinched. Cascadia Code is its wiry monoline opposite, and that wide spacing between neighbors is what you remember most.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board. Balsamiq Sans above it is looser and bolder, with smooth stencil-like channels, so the two feel pleasantly mismatched on the page.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-julius-sans-one: Balsamiq Sans carries a constant, stencil-cut weight with no pinched curves anywhere in sight. And Julius Sans One stands out most for its big gaps between letters, with capitals and lowercase nearly level.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lexend-exa: Stencil-cut channels with no pinched curves define Balsamiq Sans up top. Lexend Exa underneath draws a thickness that never shifts with direction, and its wide-open curves stay distinct, which is the real strength here.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lexend-giga: Balsamiq Sans sets the tone with the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel and smooth, unpinched curves. But Lexend Giga is the one you live with, its flat single-weight linework and generous tracking opening each word across a long stretch.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with one nib, its c ends clearly parted. Balsamiq Sans above is bolder and stencil-like, and a long stretch of the body would read steadily, with its height nearly matching the capitals.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lexend-peta: Chunky and cheerful up top, with Balsamiq Sans drawing smooth, stencil-cut channels, then Lexend Peta follows with curves that never thin and c shapes like a wide mouth. Its big x-height is the standout.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lexend-tera: Smooth, unpinched curves cut like a stencil channel give Balsamiq Sans its look. But Lexend Tera is the one that spaces out, drawing every rounded letter open like a plotter pen, with letters standing as far apart as stepping stones.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta sets tall-bodied small letters in widely tracked lines, each stroke like cut ribbon of constant width. Balsamiq Sans is the bolder voice, best at making a line loud.
